name: Concord

queries.query: site:cityofconcord.org GIS parcel map Concord California official
queries.result: Found the official City of Concord GIS Map Portal, which identifies a Public Parcel Viewer and links to Contra Costa County GIS data.

queries.query: Concord California mapa parcelas GIS oficial
queries.result: Found the official City portal and Contra Costa County public assessor parcel download; the county is the local cadastral/assessor data custodian for the parcel dataset.

discoveryMethod: Separate official English discovery routes followed by direct inspection of the City of Concord GIS service and Contra Costa County public assessor parcel dataset.
queryOutcomes: The city portal confirms a public parcel viewer and delegates broader GIS layers to Contra Costa County. The county's current September 2026 public parcel ZIP provided a bounded native-ID and polygon extraction in EPSG:2227, transformed to WGS84 for the retained sample.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Contra Costa County Department of Information Technology/GIS is evidenced as the county parcel-data custodian; City of Concord provides the municipal GIS portal and public parcel-viewer entry point.
sourceAssessment.sourceCrs: EPSG:2227 (NAD83 / California zone 3, US survey feet)
sourceAssessment.scope: Countywide public assessor parcel shapefile; Concord citywide completeness was not independently established from the bounded sample.

sample.note: Retained properties contain only canonical native APN identity; all other source attributes were discarded.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; exact point preserved and used without coordinate shifting.
